kit_version.source: the release identity, DERIVED from release-manifest.json version — one root for the whole stamp chain; stamped into every scaffolded enforcement file and locked by the smoke stamp lock

product_name.source: the product name — no machine source; the manifest is its canonical home and the product_name class polices the docs against it

product_name_legacy.source: the retired display + informal names (what the product_name class flags)

repo_slug.source: the GitHub slug; clone URLs in the docs compare against THIS

stack_coverage.source: validators/validate-transition.cjs LANG_WRITE_CALLS ∩ validators/validate-test-honesty.cjs EVALUATED_LANGS (key sets must agree; display-mapped)

state_file.source: the session-axis state file — the only session-role marker

tier_names.source: M26.D (the ratified collapse, calibration-core.json tiers): two tiers — Full the merged default, Lite the low-ceremony escape; what project-config.md persists

note: The kit's self-descriptive facts. DERIVED (machine source) / BOUND (re-parsed from a home doc's structure) / REFERENCED (read live from golden-manifest.json) / DECLARED (a decision with no machine source — the manifest is its canonical home; the identity classes police the docs against it) — never hand-stated twice. Regenerate: node validators/validate-entry-docs.cjs --write-manifest. Policed by validators/validate-entry-docs.cjs (the entry-doc set) + selfCheck (derived-vs-stored rot). scaffold_counts is read LIVE from golden-manifest.json, not copied.
